items.headline: Broadcom in talks to raise $70–80 billion in debt for AI chip financing deal supporting Anthropic and other AI companies
Broadcom negotiating more than $60 billion in debt financing package for custom AI chips and hardware, including $60–70 billion senior tranche and ~$30 billion junior tranche
Broadcom’s massive AI debt financing plans highlight competitive pressures as Google expands AI hardware partnership with Marvell; AVGO shares down ~6.2%
